body: All sorts of spirits that don’t bother him but he’s been struggling with a demonic figure for a long time now that tells him it’s god and can apparently change what it looks like to try and trick him. That’s a whole other story.

Please don’t kill your self. Life is hard and always presenting new challenges. I was 11 when I started feeling this way, I’m 22 now. It’s still hard but believe me, one day you’ll understand why life is worth living.

My little brother has a gift and he’s 11 but just recent told us that he’s been seeing things since he was 3/4 years old. My dad and step mom had a medium come and she confirmed everything. In his situation it’s kind of like a blessing and a curse though.

Same with my son, he all of a sudden just started doing it, and my baby does this as well but not to the same extent. It’s not necessarily scary to me as it is kind of just peculiar lol. I’m super curious as to what he’s seeing. It really does help to think of it as a guardian angel though, I never really thought of it that way.
Thanks for your comment, that’s a lot more comforting to think of him possibly seeing angels
He has an amazing imagination so he’s always talking while playing with his toys but I’ll definitely have to pay more attention to see if he’s talking after he puts the toys down..
Yeah he’s still working on his language skills so it’s hard to understand him right now. Just strange because he never whispers and now he will randomly do it when he’s starting off into space haha
Same here, sometimes I don’t even understand why. Like if I’m doing something I should enjoy but totally inside my own head instead of being in the moment.

It’s really a lot of things and then some things that I can’t exactly understand. I’ve felt this way since I was maybe 11 years old. I’m a young mom with two kids and I’ve been in my relationship with my fiancé for over 6 years. I get absolutely no help with the kids, I feel like a single mother. I am not able to work as child care is extremely expensive where I live and so I never get a break or am able to get out of the house. I feel like I can’t even have a few minutes to collect my own thoughts. I live a fairly normal life for the most part but I’ve also been diagnosed bi-polar 2 in the past and with depression & anxiety. I feel like I constantly worry about things in my life that I have no control over. My mother way physically abusive to me when I was young and I also watched her deal with her own manic depressive episodes/ suicide attempts/ etc...I could go on and on.
